series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

derived.$reason: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against.

country_profile.$note: Population is World Bank SP.POP.TOTL for the latest year published in the 2015-2025 window. Income group is the World Bank's own classification, not a UNFCCC one.

ndc_registry.$note: The document this record was built from is dated 2021-12-23. The registry's latest active submission is The Republic of Korea's 2035 NDC, dated 2025-12-26, and has not been read; no figure above comes from it.

ndc_assessment.vintage: First (I)NDC round, as assessed by WRI CAIT (2016). Not the latest submission.
ndc_assessment.summary: Korea plans to reduce its greenhouse gas emissions by 37% from the business-as-usual (BAU, 850.6 MtCO 2 eq) level by 2030 across all economic sectors. The INDC includes a section on adaptation.
ndc_assessment.ghg_target: 37% reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the BAU scenario (850.6 MtCO2e)
ndc_assessment.gases: CO2, CH4, N2O, HFCs, PFCs, SF6
ndc_assessment.sectors: Energy, industrial processes and product use, agriculture and waste
ndc_assessment.$note: Third-party assessment of the first (I)NDC round. It is not merged into ndc.*, is not used by derive(), and does not appear on the dial as a target.

evidence.sentence: ensure the clarity and transparency of the target, the government replaced the previous target with an absolute target which is to reduce 24.4% from 2017 emissions level by 2030.

ndc_document.$note: Read by DS-06-NDC from the First NDC as mirrored by openclimatedata; unfccc.int itself refuses this engine's requests. The figure above is this engine's reading of the sentence quoted, not a figure the document tabulates.

Non-CO₂ greenhouse gases only (CH₄, N₂O, F-gases), AR5 GWP100, excluding LULUCF (EDGAR 2024). CO₂ is omitted for licence reasons, so this is not a national total.

Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions.

emissions_profile.$note: Headline totals are OWID only. OWID's CO₂ sub-totals are fossil/industrial CO₂ by fuel, not a full sectoral GHG breakdown, and do not sum to total_mtco2e. DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: Republic of Korea submitted its Enhanced NDC (2021) on 2021-12-23; no numeric target has been extracted from it. A later submission, The Republic of Korea's 2035 NDC, was filed on 2025-12-26; it has not been read, so no figure here comes from it. 75 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (29). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 711.2 MtCO₂e, DS-35 630.6 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 68.3 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 37% reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the BAU scenario (850.6 MtCO2e) It was classed unconditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.43°C under SSP1-2.6 to +4.91°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
